# Paul Kreations

> Paul Kreations is a solo app development studio run by Debapriyo Paul, based in Kolkata, India. It builds Android apps, web experiences and games.

## Products

- [Where Is My Money? (WIMM)](https://www.paulkreations.com/wimm): a personal finance app for Indian users. Local-first data storage, optional Premium cloud sync, a referral program and promo offers. Available on Google Play.
- [Henstel](https://www.paulkreations.com/henstel): a kitchen companion app that combines curated cookbooks with intelligent pantry organisation, expiry reminders and AI recipe help. Available on Google Play.
- [Natural Farming](https://www.paulkreations.com/natural-farming): an educational app with 37 lessons, daily quizzes and a community for learning sustainable, chemical-free farming, in 22 languages. Available on Google Play.
- [Surround It](https://www.paulkreations.com/surround-it): a Tiger vs Hunters strategy board game for Android, playable offline against the computer. Available on Google Play.
